title: Dehwari language - Wikipedia
text: Dehwari (دهواری, Dehwārī) is a Persian dialect [2] spoken by some 19,000 Dehwar people in Balochistan, Pakistan as of 2018. [1] Most of the Dehwari speakers are concentrated in Mastung, Khuzdar, Nushk, Kharan, Sarlath District, Dalbandin, and Kalat.
